title: Notification row
brief: An inbox notification: round initials avatar, a bold name with the action, a quieter line with project and time, and an unread dot on the right.

inspiration.note: Took the idea of a coloured edge stripe on a notification; ours is an inbox row with an avatar and soft card.
Took the two-level text (bold title, quiet detail line); added the unread dot and initials avatar.
